fetch_method: WebSearch tool result snippets only (WebFetch blocked — see note)
webfetch_blocked_note: This session's organizational egress proxy returned HTTP 403 (policy denial, confirmed via the proxy status endpoint) for every direct WebFetch attempt against .gov.in, .ac.in, .edu.in, and Wikipedia domains during data collection. This is a fixed org-level policy, not a retriable client error, and was not routed around. As a result, no source page in this dataset was directly fetched and re-read for confirmation; every fact was instead sourced from WebSearch tool result snippets, each cited by URL in the dataset's source_url column. Confidence scores were capped accordingly (see metadata/*.metadata.json confidence_calibration_note).
